verdict.rationale: Stable documents the USPS Form 1583 onboarding and signature-packet process needed for CMRA-based virtual addresses, and distinguishes registered-agent addresses (no 1583 needed) from CMRA addresses, showing some awareness of where an address type is/isn't valid (stable-docs-5, stable-docs-32/33/34). It also states the virtual address can be used with the IRS, state, and vendors (stable-docs-18), but there is no explicit claim or guidance about banks or payment processors specifically accepting the address as proof of business address. Missing for 10: explicit statement that banks/payment processors accept this address as proof, specific KYC/bank-acceptance guidance, and any caveats about processors that reject CMRA addresses.
